ctx.x: This was somebody who, but he wouldn't play until sing, sing got up and played a little bit on the bass, and then he came up and he said, come here, I'm going to show you how to do it, young fella. And then sing went over and took the banjo, and played the banjo. And I didn't have the camera that day.
Yeah, a tall, very tall fella. Tall, slim.
